title: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli
subtitle: in a yoghurt and parmesan sauce
description: Store-bought spinach and ricotta ravioli served over a pool of seasoned goat's milk yoghurt and finished with grated parmesan. A spoonful of melted butter on top is optional.

steps.text: Mix the yoghurt with salt and pepper ahead of time and leave the sauce at room temperature.
Cook the ravioli in a pot with 7 litres of lightly salted water for 5 to 6 minutes.
Pour about 130 g of the yoghurt sauce into each shallow bowl, arrange the ravioli on top and sprinkle with grated parmesan. Drizzle a spoonful of melted butter over each serving if you like.
